Entry Prince and Princess Princes and princesses in Westeros often belong to the royal bloodline, and the "princes" of Dorne also carry a unique tradition of regional rule. The court regards titles as the order of succession and the value of marriage alliances. Ordinary people often only judge whether a royal is a member of the royal family based on his entourage, clothing and rumors. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
